What This Actually Is and Why It Matters

Sovereign commerce infrastructure is a self-owned, self-controlled digital commerce stack that gives you complete control over your online store and payment processing. It's not a workaround or a hack, but a base-layer infrastructure solution that empowers you to collect cryptocurrency payments directly from your customers, without any intermediaries or fees. This is crucial for creators who need to sell digital products like beats, courses, or software, where the value lies in the intellectual property, not in physical goods that need to be shipped.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At the heart of sovereign commerce infrastructure is a combination of free and paid tools that work together seamlessly to create a fully operational online store. You'll use GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. Each component plays a vital role in ensuring that your digital products are delivered to customers instantly and securely, while you collect payments directly in your chosen cryptocurrency.
